chart.title: Share of companies using artificial intelligence technology
chart.subtitle: Share of companies using AI technology (e.g., machine learning, computer vision, or natural language processing) in at least one business function. “Use” covers a wide range, from a few employees experimenting with AI to it being fully scaled across the organization.
chart.note: Companies represent a range of industries, sizes, functional specialties, and tenures. To adjust for differences in response rates, the data are weighted by the contribution of each respondent's nation to global GDP.
chart.citation: McKinsey & Company via AI Index Report

pct_of_respondents.descriptionShort: Share of companies using AI technology (e.g., machine learning, computer vision, or natural language processing) in at least one business function.
pct_of_respondents.descriptionKey:
- Based on McKinsey & Company’s annual [“State of AI” surveys](https://www.mckinsey.com/capabilities/quantumblack/our-insights/the-state-of-ai) of organizations across many countries, industries, and company sizes.
- Organizations are counted as using AI if they report using it in at least one business function.
- Responses are self-reported and should be interpreted as indicative of trends rather than precise measures of global adoption.
- Reported use often reflects early-stage adoption, such as experimentation or pilot projects, rather than widespread deployment.
- To account for differences in response rates, results are weighted by each country’s contribution to global GDP.
pct_of_respondents.descriptionProcessing: We combine data from multiple releases of the AI Index Report. When the same year appears in more than one release, we use the most recent version.
pct_of_respondents.citationShort: McKinsey & Company via AI Index Report – with major processing by Our World in Data
